title: Party (DRAFT)
description: A person or organization known to the platform. Identity is recorded once here; what they are in relation to a piece of land is a land role, not a property of this record. DRAFT — not approved.

partyType.description: A cooperative, association or council is an organization. Modeling it as a person would misrepresent collective land control.

displayName.description: As the party gives it. No assumption of given/family name order.

community.description: Settlement or community the party identifies with. Free text: administrative divisions are unreliable at this scale.

contact.description: All optional. Many smallholders have no email, and a phone may be shared across a household.

preferredLanguage.description: BCP 47 tag. Required in practice for consent to be meaningful.

identityEvidence.description: References into evidence storage (PARTY-002). Never the documents themselves.

kind.description: OPEN QUESTION: left as free text deliberately. Enumerating document types across jurisdictions is a research task, and a wrong enum would block legitimate enrollment.

dataClassification.description: Drawn from the approved event envelope's vocabulary. A party record is never public or internal. OPEN QUESTION: cultural_restricted (ADR-016) may be mandatory for Indigenous communities.

_notDefinedDeliberately.nationalIdNumber: Excluded. High-harm identifier; needs a separate decision with legal input.
_notDefinedDeliberately.bankDetails: Excluded. Belongs with FIN-001 payments, which has no contract.
_notDefinedDeliberately.homeLocation: Excluded. Geolocating a person's home endangers them in contested-tenure settings.
_notDefinedDeliberately.dateOfBirth: Excluded until a stated purpose requires it.
